reference: USGS OFR 2008-1159 equations 1A/1B/2/3A and infinite-slope stress balance
limitations: Wet/tension-saturated, homogeneous isotropic columns only; unsaturated coupling and upward initial flow are unsupported
D8 uses instantaneous strictly-downhill transfer; terminal excess includes pits/outlets; no storage, flat resolution or travel time
Without routing, water-balance volumes assume independent 1 m2 columns
Minimum FS is sampled at requested depths/times; no continuous minimum search or USGS legacy parity certification
